name: listSort
description: Sorts list elements according to a sort type and sort order.
syntax: listSort( string list, [string sort_type], [string sort_order], [string delimiters], [boolean includeEmptyFields] )

params.name: sort_type
params.description:
there are different sort types:

- numeric (sort by number)
- text (sorts text alphabetically and case sensitive)
- textnocase (sorts text alphabetically and ignore case sensitivity)

params.name: sort_order
params.description:
sort direction:

- asc(default): ascending sort order
- desc: descending sort order

params.name: delimiters
params.description: Characters that separate list elements. The default value is comma.

params.name: includeEmptyFields
params.description: if set to true, empty values are included as well
